title: Uruguayan-Style Pork Chops with Earthy Vegetables
description: A hearty and delicious Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring juicy pork chops baked to perfection with earthy vegetables.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the pork chops to a baking dish and set aside.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, onions, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are lightly browned.
Transfer the vegetables to the baking dish with the pork chops.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the pork chops are cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
